tasks.title: First table
tasks.statement: Create a table tags: id (integer, primary key) and name (text). The result is checked by the table structure.
tasks.hint: CREATE TABLE name (column type, column type, …);

tasks.title: Column types
tasks.statement: Create a table items: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, price REAL, stock INTEGER.

tasks.title: NOT NULL
tasks.statement: Create a table users: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, nickname TEXT (optional).

tasks.title: DEFAULT
tasks.statement: Create a table tasks: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', priority INTEGER DEFAULT 3.

tasks.title: DEFAULT in action
tasks.statement: Create the table tasks (as in the previous exercise), add a row (title = `'написать отчёт'`) without status and priority, and make sure the default values were filled in.

tasks.title: Text key
tasks.statement: Create a table countries: code TEXT PRIMARY KEY (for example, 'RU'), name TEXT NOT NULL.

tasks.title: Composite key
tasks.statement: Create a table wishlist: customer_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, product_id). A composite key forbids repeats of the pair.

tasks.title: UNIQUE
tasks.statement: Create a table accounts: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, login TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE. Then INSERT OR IGNORE two rows with the same login 'anna' — the second will be skipped.
tasks.hint: OR IGNORE silently skips a row that violates a constraint.

tasks.title: CHECK
tasks.statement: Create a table goods: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, price INTEGER CHECK (price >= 0). Use INSERT OR IGNORE to insert the rows ('a', 100) and ('b', -5); the second will violate the CHECK.

tasks.title: CHECK with a list
tasks.statement: Create a table orders2: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('new', 'paid', 'shipped')). Use INSERT OR IGNORE to insert the statuses 'paid' and 'lost' — the last one will be rejected.

tasks.title: NOT NULL in action
tasks.statement: Create a table people: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL. INSERT OR IGNORE two rows: (`'Анна'`) and (NULL). One will remain.

tasks.title: Composite UNIQUE
tasks.statement: Create a table slots: room TEXT, hour INTEGER, UNIQUE (room, hour). Use INSERT OR IGNORE to insert ('A', 9), ('A', 10), ('A', 9), ('B', 9) — the repeat of a pair will be rejected.

tasks.title: Foreign key
tasks.statement: Create a table reviews: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), stars INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stars BETWEEN 1 AND 5), body TEXT. The result is checked by the table's foreign keys.
tasks.hint: REFERENCES table(column) declares a foreign key.

tasks.title: Two foreign keys
tasks.statement: Create a table favorites: customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), PRIMARY KEY (customer_id, product_id).

tasks.title: ON DELETE CASCADE
tasks.statement: Create a table comments: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, body TEXT. The on_delete rule of the foreign key is checked.

tasks.title: AUTOINCREMENT
tasks.statement: Create a table log: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, msg TEXT. Insert three messages 'a','b','c', delete the last one and insert 'd' — AUTOINCREMENT does not reuse the freed number.
tasks.hint: Number 3 is already used, so 'd' will get 4.

tasks.title: New column
tasks.statement: Add a column phone TEXT to the customers table (ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN).

tasks.title: Column with DEFAULT
tasks.statement: Add a column archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 to products. Existing rows will get 0.

tasks.title: New column and data
tasks.statement: Add a column note TEXT to orders and fill it for order 1 with the value `'подарок'`.

tasks.title: Rename a table
tasks.statement: Rename the table products to goods (ALTER TABLE … RENAME TO …). The row count in goods is checked.

tasks.title: Rename a column
tasks.statement: Rename the column title of the table products to name (RENAME COLUMN).

tasks.title: Drop a column
tasks.statement: Drop the column brand from the table products (ALTER TABLE … DROP COLUMN …).

tasks.title: DROP TABLE
tasks.statement: Drop the table order_items (DROP TABLE). The list of remaining tables is checked.

tasks.title: IF EXISTS
tasks.statement: Drop the table temp_report if it exists (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS …), and once more — there must be no error. Then create temp_report(id INTEGER). The result is checked by structure.
tasks.hint: IF EXISTS makes the command safe to run again.

tasks.title: IF NOT EXISTS
tasks.statement: Create a table cache(k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT) with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — twice in a row, without an error. Then insert one row ('a','1').

tasks.title: Table from a query
tasks.statement: Create a table vip_report from a query: id, name, city of the VIP customers (CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT …).
tasks.hint: Constraints and keys are not copied.

tasks.title: Summary table
tasks.statement: Create a table sales_by_status(status, n, revenue) from a query: the number of orders and the total by status (use GROUP BY status).

tasks.title: Temporary table
tasks.statement: Create a temporary table top_products (CREATE TEMP TABLE … AS SELECT …) with the three most expensive products: title, price.

tasks.title: Generated column
tasks.statement: Create a table lines: qty INTEGER, price INTEGER, total INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (qty * price) STORED. Insert (2, 150) and (3, 40); total is computed by itself.

tasks.title: Type affinity
tasks.statement: SQLite converts values to the column's type (affinity). Create a table t(a INTEGER), insert '123' (as a string) and 'abc'. Output typeof(a) for both rows in ascending rowid order.
tasks.hint: '123' becomes a number, and 'abc' stays text.

tasks.title: Detailed catalog
tasks.statement: Output the table names and the number of columns in each: sqlite_master JOIN pragma_table_info(name); columns name, cols; ordered by name.

tasks.title: Recreate with a new constraint
tasks.statement: In SQLite a constraint cannot be added with ALTER — the table is recreated. Create goods_new(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0)), copy id, title, price from products into it, drop products and rename goods_new to products.

tasks.title: Split a table
tasks.statement: In the table flat(order_id, customer, city, product, price) the data is duplicated. Create a table cust(customer, city) without repeats and prod(product, price) without repeats (CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT DISTINCT …).

tasks.title: Table structure
tasks.statement: HR database. For the table employees, output the name, type and notnull flag of each column in declaration order: SELECT name, type, "notnull" FROM pragma_table_info('employees').

tasks.title: Table indexes
tasks.statement: Create a table u(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT UNIQUE, code TEXT UNIQUE) and output the number of its indexes (pragma_index_list) as n — each UNIQUE creates an index.

tasks.title: School: a new table
tasks.statement: School database. Create a table teachers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT) and add two teachers: `'Н. Крылова'` (subject `'Математика'`) and `'А. Беляев'` (subject `'Физика'`).

tasks.title: Movies: genres
tasks.statement: Movies database. Create a lookup table genres(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY) and fill it with the distinct genres from movies (INSERT … SELECT DISTINCT genre …).
